findings.title: 成功工具结果因固定元数据超限被转成失败后，与投影解析规则冲突
findings.trigger: A registered worker successfully returns many authorized existing artifacts; full display paths in resource_refs render above 32KiB. A 100-path shape with 407-byte paths fits default 256KiB worker result line size. The current projection refusal branch is exercised.
findings.impact: Run records the refused projection then projected_tool_item rejects it as corrupt stored state before the next model request. Full HTTP/worker execution and later recovery were not run.
findings.fixDirection: Distinguish raw-success identity from projected failure metadata in the producer/reader contract, preserving the authoritative raw result and 32KiB budget.
